title: 'Sleeping' Trump In Blue Suit Breaks Vatican Protocol At Pope's Funeral? US Prez An 'Embarrassment'?
shows: Real funeral pool footage: wide shot of Pope Francis's coffin being carried in procession past the seated world leaders, Trump visible among the crowd -- the ceremony continuing. Replaces the original 19.0-23.5s trim of this same source, which overlapped a ~2s genuine broadcast-feed freeze glitch at ~21.0-23.3s baked into the original video (confirmed via ffprobe freezedetect + framemd5 on the raw source: the freeze is in the pool feed itself, not a pipeline artifact -- the earlier local trim just happened to sit on top of it). A first replacement attempt (23.4-25.3s, Trump applauding) was itself too close to the pipeline's very low motion tolerance once re-encoded through the render pipeline's fps/zoom/concat chain and produced a shorter secondary freeze; this final in/out (29.5-34.0s) has substantially more real motion (walking pallbearers) and was verified freeze-free both raw and after simulating the full render_beat.py shot+concat chain.
